walkthrough.setup.idioma.title: Choose your language
walkthrough.setup.idioma.description:
The IDE follows your system language; English and Portuguese (Brazil) are built in.
[Change the language](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22idioma%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.ia.title: Connect the AI you have
walkthrough.setup.ia.description:
Claude, Codex or Gemini through your subscription, an API key, local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or any ACP agent. With none, the IDE works as an editor.
[Set up AI](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22ia%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.importar.title: Bring your editor along
walkthrough.setup.importar.description:
Settings, keybindings, snippets and extensions from VS Code, Insiders or VSCodium.
[Import](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22importar%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.tema.title: Pick a theme
walkthrough.setup.tema.description:
FaKL Noite matches the Desk and the chat; any VS Code theme works.
[Pick a theme](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22tema%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.permissoes.title: Permissions and spending caps
walkthrough.setup.permissoes.description:
How much agents can do without asking, and a daily cap for each provider.
[Set permissions](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22permissoes%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.github.title: Sign in to GitHub
walkthrough.setup.github.description:
Pull requests, reviews, Actions and notifications for your whole account.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22github%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.fontes.title: Agents, skills and MCPs
walkthrough.setup.fontes.description:
The IDE ships with none: add your own sources (a git repository or a folder) and install what you want.
[Add a source](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22fontes%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.vault.title: Notes vault
walkthrough.setup.vault.description:
Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes with git sync.
[Set up the vault](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22vault%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.remoto.title: Phone remote control
walkthrough.setup.remoto.description:
Follow and command your agents from your phone through your own relay.
[Set up remote control](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22remoto%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.voz.title: Voice commands
walkthrough.setup.voz.description:
Speak a request instead of typing it.
[Choose a voice mode](command:fakl.setup.open?%5B%22voz%22%5D)
walkthrough.setup.mais.title: More integrations
walkthrough.setup.mais.description:
SSH, Hostinger, Lovable, email, settings sync and the fakl CLI in the terminal.
[Open the setup journey](command:fakl.setup.open)
walkthrough.setup.title: Get started with FaKL-Code
walkthrough.setup.description: Set up only what you use: AI, editor, integrations. Everything can be skipped and redone later.

config.mesa.abrirAoIniciar: Open the Desk, the canvas with the agents, when a folder opens.
config.providers.checkUpdates: When listing the AI providers, ask the npm registry for the latest version of each agent adapter and CLI and offer to update the outdated ones. Only the package name is sent; nothing is ever updated without your confirmation.
config.update.notify: On macOS, tell me when a new FaKL-Code version is out. Windows updates itself; turn the check off for good with `update.mode` set to `none`.
config.claude.perguntarConta: When creating a Claude agent, ask which signed-in account to use. Off: the active account is used.
config.limits.providers: Plan caps for each provider, to show the percentage used in the usage windows. E.g.: `{ "anthropic": { "sessionTokens": 2000000, "weeklyTokens": 40000000 }, "google": { "dailyRequests": 1000 } }`. Without a cap, shows only what was spent. Codex reports the real percentage.
config.limits.claude.sessionTokens: Tokens of your Claude plan's 5-hour session, to show the percentage used. 0: shows only the tokens spent.
config.limits.claude.sessionTokens.depre: Use `fakl.limits.providers` → `anthropic.sessionTokens`; this value still applies while that one is not set.
config.limits.claude.weeklyTokens: Tokens of your Claude plan's week, to show the percentage used. 0: shows only the tokens spent.
config.limits.claude.weeklyTokens.deprec: Use `fakl.limits.providers` → `anthropic.weeklyTokens`; this value still applies while that one is not set.
config.github.clientId: Client ID of the FaKL-Code OAuth App with device flow enabled. Empty: sign in through the IDE's GitHub account, the gh CLI or a token.
